const stats = items[0].json.summary || {};

const reportText = `PAWLSE WEEKLY OPERATIONS REPORT\n` +
  `Generated: ${new Date().toISOString()}\n\n` +
  `📊 RESCUES:\n` +
  `• Total Reports: ${stats.rescues?.total || 0}\n` +
  `• Pending: ${stats.rescues?.pending || 0}\n` +
  `• In Progress: ${stats.rescues?.in_progress || 0}\n` +
  `• Resolved: ${stats.rescues?.resolved || 0}\n\n` +
  `🐾 ADOPTIONS:\n` +
  `• Total Applications: ${stats.adoptions?.total_applications || 0}\n` +
  `• Pending: ${stats.adoptions?.pending || 0}\n` +
  `• Approved: ${stats.adoptions?.approved || 0}\n\n` +
  `💰 DONATIONS:\n` +
  `• Total Cash Raised: ₱${(stats.donations?.total_cash_amount || 0).toLocaleString()}\n` +
  `• Cash Donations Count: ${stats.donations?.verified_cash_count || 0}\n` +
  `• In-Kind Donations: ${stats.donations?.verified_inkind_count || 0}\n\n` +
  `🤝 VOLUNTEERS:\n` +
  `• Active Volunteers: ${stats.volunteers?.active_count || 0}\n` +
  `• Pending Applications: ${stats.volunteers?.pending_applications || 0}\n\n` +
  `🏠 SHELTER ANIMALS:\n` +
  `• In Shelter: ${stats.shelter_animals?.total || 0}\n` +
  `• Available for Adoption: ${stats.shelter_animals?.available || 0}\n` +
  `• Total Adopted: ${stats.shelter_animals?.adopted || 0}`;

return [{
  json: {
    subject: `Pawlse Weekly Operations Report - ${new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-PH')}`,
    body: reportText
  }
}];
